scenes.say: Formula Three champion, Formula Two leader a year later, and in twenty twenty-seven he's in Formula One.
Rafael Câmara is twenty-one, Brazilian, and a product of the Ferrari academy.
Last year he won Formula Three with Trident and wrapped it up with a round to spare.
In Formula Two he went straight for the title. His main rival is Red Bull junior Nikola Tsolov.
Haas didn't wait for the finale and signed Câmara to replace Esteban Ocon.
The Formula Two title will be settled in the last two rounds, Qatar and Abu Dhabi.
Follow the Formula Two standings on LapRadar.

title: Rafael Câmara: from F3 champion to Formula 1 in two years
